It still binds source issue 165 / PR 166 / old base, reports 15/15 and 119/119, and retains the explicitly forbidden prospective sentence “will be added…”. Therefore the durable evidence surface does not bind PR #186 final head or actual claimed counts.
2. The required independently named adversarial cases are absent from the 17 test methods: no missing/wrong immutable-admission test, no nonzero-execution test, no non-`TASK_OUTCOME` test, and no separate wrong PR repository/branch/base failures. The suite has only a positive bound-PR test plus PR-absent rejection; envelope repository rejection is not the required PR-provenance matrix.
3. Remote-existing receipt recognition still uses substring membership (`receipt_key in body`) rather than parsing and validating a bounded receipt. A malformed or unrelated comment containing the key can therefore be treated as `confirmed-existing` provenance and drive validation-record creation.
